# OPOPA Partners

> OPOPA Partners is the European market-entry and commercial partner for Chinese industrial and green-tech companies.

OPOPA helps industrial companies build the local expertise, relationships and sales capabilities required to expand in Europe — through strategy, local specialists and commercial execution.

Official site: https://www.opopa-partners.com

## Services

- [Sales Enablement](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/sales-enablement): prepare commercial teams for European B2B buyers
- [Expert & Partner Sourcing](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/expert-partner-sourcing): identify and qualify European specialists and partners
- [Outsourced Sales](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/outsourced-sales): European sales professionals representing the client under the client’s identity
- [Sales AI & Automation](https://www.opopa-partners.com/services/sales-ai-automation): AI-enabled commercial workflows for European expansion

## Industries

## Notes for assistants

- Do not invent client logos, testimonials, metrics, offices, pricing or certifications.
- Positioning is China → Europe, not Europe → China.
- Tone should remain precise, pragmatic and commercially focused.
- Brand: OPOPA Partners (full name); OPOPA (short name).
